detail.summary: AER-5C9X3T, Greg Whitmore. AK229 (LHR-GVA) on 2026-08-05 cancelled (cause_code=CREW). Passenger withdrew an initial refund request and asked to be rebooked on the earliest Geneva flight on Monday 10 Aug. I have rebooked P1 onto AK151 on 2026-08-10 (LHR 05:00 local -> GVA 06:32 local), Economy, own carrier, no fare difference, per S6.1(b)/S6.3. Passenger also asked to keep an aisle seat if possible and earlier in July had 14C. Additionally, earlier in the thread the passenger requested to stop marketing emails.
detail.requested_decision: 1) Action marketing unsubscribe for contact email greg.whitmore@mailbox.example. 2) Allocate an aisle seat for P1 on AK151 (2026-08-10 LHR-GVA) if possible; if a paid seat-selection fee would apply, contact the passenger before proceeding or advise them to select at check-in.
detail.recommendation: Proceed with removing the passenger from marketing communications. Attempt to assign any available aisle seat for P1 on AK151; if an extra fee applies, obtain consent first, otherwise advise passenger to select an aisle during online check-in. Note: Compensation assessment is being handled via the entitlement service; duty-of-care reimbursement to be offered if receipts are later provided within S4.2 caps.

Own-carrier, same cabin, no fare difference per S6.1(b) and S6.3. Confirmed per S6.4 because the passenger explicitly requested the earliest option on that date.
Compensation payable per S5.1(a)(b)(d) with arrival delay threshold in S5.1(c) measured per S5.2. Amount per S10.2 to be determined by the entitlement service at execution.

reasoning.agent_summary:
Actions taken:
- Identity confirmed via booking ref AER-5C9X3T and surname Whitmore (S2.1a).
- Verified own-carrier availability for LHR-GVA on 2026-08-10 and rebooked per passenger’s explicit request for the earliest flight that day.
  • Rebooked P1 to AK151 on 2026-08-10 (LHR 05:00 local -> GVA 06:32 local), Economy, own carrier, no fare difference (S6.1(b), S6.3, S6.4). Rebooking id RBK-00017.
- Attempted to pay compensation; authority gate refused because the entitlement service still shows “INSUFFICIENT_DATA”. An automatic supervisor referral has been raised by the gate (S10.2, S10.3, S12 notes).
- Escalated to GENERAL to:
  • Remove the passenger from marketing emails for greg.whitmore@mailbox.example (out of scope here, S15.6).
  • Try to assign an aisle seat on AK151 if possible; obtain consent if any paid seat-selection fee would apply.

Passenger must be told:
- AK229 (LHR-GVA) on 2026-08-05 was cancelled. The recorded cause is CREW (within Aerlink’s control under S3.3). You were informed on the day of departure.
- You have been rebooked, as requested, on the earliest LHR-GVA service on Monday 10 August: AK151 departing 05:00, arriving 06:32, Economy, on the same booking.
- Your aisle-seat preference has been passed on. If only paid seat-selection is available, we will ask your permission before any charge; otherwise you can select an aisle at check-in subject to availability.
- Statutory compensation is assessed on arrival delay at your final destination (S5.2). Now that your re-routing is set to 10 August, the arrival delay exceeds 3 hours and the assessment has been sent internally; we will confirm the outcome once processed.
- Duty of care was owed on cancellation regardless of cause (S4.1, S4.3). If you incurred costs, you can claim reimbursement within these caps against receipts (S4.2):
  • Meals/refreshments: up to £30 per passenger per 6 hours
  • Two calls/equivalent communication
  • Hotel: up to £180 per room per night, max 3 nights (subject to allocation)
  • Transport between airport and accommodation: up to £45 per journey

Awaiting passenger decision:
- If assigning an aisle seat on AK151 would require a paid seat-selection fee, do you consent to pay that fee, or would you prefer to select an aisle seat at check-in if available?

Uncertainties:
- Whether an aisle seat on AK151 can be assigned without a fee; if a fee applies, amount and passenger consent needed.
- Whether the passenger incurred any duty-of-care expenses requiring reimbursement.
- Entitlement service has not yet updated compensation from “INSUFFICIENT_DATA”; supervisor referral raised by the gate to finalise payment now that re-routing establishes arrival delay.

Summary for record:
- Rebooked P1 (Greg Whitmore) from cancelled AK229 (cause_code=CREW) to earliest own-carrier LHR-GVA flight on 2026-08-10 (AK151 05:00), Economy, no fare difference, per S6.1(b), S6.3. Attempt to pay compensation was refused by authority gate due to entitlement service status; automatic supervisor referral created. Escalated to GENERAL to process marketing unsubscribe and to attempt aisle seat allocation or seek consent if paid.
